TRAFFIC ADVISORY
Day 16 - Wednesday 15th October, 2025
CONSTRUCTION OF THE MAIN CARRIAGE WAYS OF OUTER SOUTHERN EXPRESSWAYOSEX FROM RING ROAD I JUNCTION TO RING ROAD II JUNCTION

Motorists using the Apo-Wasa road in the FCT are hereby notified of the above mentioned event and should ensure full compliance to the road design: Inbound (Right hand side) and outbound lane (left hand side).

The power station near Gudu cementary will be the venue of the event. As such, traffic will be slightly affected during the movement of dignitaries.

Traffic and Security personnel will be deployed accordingly at 0800hr to ensure strict compliance to the road design.

Signed
Head Traffic, DRTS
